sarah-sales: Quick check — AuroraFin wants a POC next week. Requirements: SSO (SAML via Okta), SCIM user sync (delta + bulk), RBAC mapping, and domain claim for multiple subdomains. Need answers on: SCIM delta behavior & rate limits, domain claim process/timeline, Dedicated POC pricing, and security questionnaire items around SAML attrs. Can SE/eng confirm? @olivia-se @raj-eng

olivia-se: Ack. High level: we support SAML SP‑initiated + IdP metadata ingest, SCIM 2.0 with patch/delta + bulk import, and group->role mapping via SCIM or SAML groups. Domain claim requires DNS TXT per domain but we have an automation script to speed this up.

raj-eng: SCIM specifics — delta uses PATCH operations and our delta feed exposes only changed users. For POC we can enable the bulk import endpoint to seed users then the delta feed for ongoing sync. Default tenant rate limits: 60 req/s for SCIM endpoints (can be adjusted for Dedicated). If they plan a large sync, we recommend bulk import + paging. Example SCIM PATCH we send: 

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/2819c223-7f76-453a-919d-413861904646
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "active", "value": true},
    {"op": "replace", "path": "groups", "value": [{"value": "sales-team","display":"Sales"}]}
  ]
}
```

raj-eng: Also note: if Okta is pushing groups, we recommend SCIM group sync to avoid hitting SAML assertion size limits.

olivia-se: Domain claim flow: 1) we send DNS TXT token per domain, 2) customer adds record, 3) we verify and attach domain to tenant. We cannot rely on wildcards for top-level domain claims (no wildcard domain claims), but we can support subdomain patterns via a single verification path if they control the parent zone and are okay with a single TXT across subdomains (ops must approve). Typical turnaround: DNS verification completes within minutes after record propagation; allow 24 hr for conservative scheduling.

mike-infra: Pricing for Dedicated POC: we can offer a 2‑week Dedicated trial at a fixed daily rate or provide Hosted credits + elevated quota for the POC. Ballpark for their expected throughput (approx 100k tokens/day, moderate concurrency) — estimated $2,500/week on Dedicated stage; exact quote from sales ops. If they need sustained throughput + SLA, we should move to a reserved commit. @sarah-sales I can draft a quick quote. :moneybag:

julia-legal: For the security questionnaire, ask them to provide what they already have filled; common asks we need to address: SAML metadata + endpoints, SCIM scope and retention, SOC2 Type II report, encryption at rest and KMS controls, data residency & access controls, and RBAC admin separation. We usually provide a short packet: SOC2, pen test summary, and our whitepaper on Dedicated network isolation. If they want an ISA, that'll be a separate engagement.

sarah-sales: Helpful — one more on RBAC: Can we map Okta groups to Redwood roles and also restrict which groups are allowed to sync? They want delegated admin to manage their tenant.

olivia-se: Yes — we support group->role mapping. You can configure an allowlist of groups that map to roles so only approved groups provision roles. Delegated admin is supported for Dedicated and Private; they can have a tenant‑scoped admin role. For Hosted customers we recommend using SSO-based SCIM with an allowlist.

raj-eng: Ops note: if they expect very large group membership claims in SAML assertions, that can blow up token size — prefer SCIM groups for large orgs. Also watch for nested groups — Okta flattens them depending on config.

calendar-bot: Created invite "AuroraFin POC kickoff — auth & SCIM" for Thu 10:00 AM (30m) with #sales, @olivia-se, @raj-eng, and @julia-legal.

sarah-sales: Perfect. I'll send the security questionnaire they already filled and request the Azure/Okta metadata + list of domains. Will prep cost expectations and get back with quote by EOD. :+1:
